patterns.note: Content sections frequently alternate between a left-aligned text block and a right-aligned image, creating a balanced visual flow down the page.
Prominent, elegant display serif typography is used for all major section headings, creating a sophisticated and established brand voice.
A high-contrast color scheme of dark charcoal and white is consistently accented by a vibrant, bold red for key calls-to-action and brand elements.
Large, stylized numerical elements and section headings are revealed with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport during scroll.
A distinct red social media call-to-action bar remains sticky at the bottom right of the screen throughout the scroll.
Key historical dates are integrated as oversized, partially revealed numbers within introductory content sections, adding a sense of legacy and depth.

technique_notes: The hero section features a full-bleed video background that subtly plays, creating a dynamic yet understated visual anchor for the page.
Sections and large numerical elements are revealed with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, likely using CSS keyframes for smooth transitions.
A fixed-position social media call-to-action bar remains visible at the bottom right of the screen during scroll, ensuring constant access to social links.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant display serif headings (~3-4x body) with a clean, legible sans-serif for body text and navigation.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding (4-8px) on buttons and content cards, with a more pronounced pill shape for the sticky social media bar.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy vertical spacing between major sections, with balanced padding within content blocks and cards.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a large, elegant display serif for section titles, combined with a dynamic video hero background and scroll-triggered numerical reveals, creates a sophisticated and established brand presence that feels both modern and timeless.
